== Title ==
<span lang="ja">スノースピーダー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で1名乗せられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが乗っている。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">改造を加えたインコムＴ－４７エアスピーダー。密閉型。低温対策としてリバルサー・コイルにヒーターを追加。反乱軍は改造型スピーダーに環境に即した呼び名をつける。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Snowspeeder.

'''Lore''' — A modified Incom T-47 airspeeder. Enclosed. Heaters were added to the reversal coils as a cold-weather measure. Rebels give converted speeders names matching the environment.

'''Game text''' — May carry a total of 1 pilot or passenger. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. May move as a react only to Hoth locations.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore prints リバルサー coils, not regulator coils, and underlines 密閉型. Game text uses 位置 for Hoth sites and does not quote リアクション.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-snowspeeder-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Snowspeeder]].</ref>
